verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official `posthog-cli` built for terminals, coding agents, scripts and CI/CD. It covers shell access to the API and MCP tool catalog (including SQL), source-map upload, schema and task management, headless env-var auth for agents, and an install path that adds instructions to your coding agent; an agentic `@posthog/wizard` CLI handles setup and signup as well. A probe confirms the CLI docs page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in real agent workflows.
